description: This file is a shell script containing test cases for a Git repository selection utility, specifically testing repository discovery and disambiguation logic in various scenarios.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Removes temporary directories created for testing to ensure a clean state.

methods.name: make_tree
methods.description: Creates a new Git repository and makes an initial commit.

methods.name: make_bare
methods.description: Creates a new bare Git repository with an initial commit.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Fetches a repository from a given directory, then clones it locally.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Checks if the fetched and cloned repositories contain the expected latest commit message.
